title: Composition of numbers
examples: Teacher, can we show the number five in other ways?
How many ways can we make the number five?
What are the parts that make up five?

explain.say: Today we are learning about number bonds. This means finding different ways to make a number.
We can look at the number five. We can find two smaller numbers that add up to five.

items: These numbers add up to five

explain.say: One way to make five is using two and three. Two plus three equals five.
Another way to make five is using four and one. Four plus one also equals five.
We can also use three and two. Three plus two makes the number five again.

faq.a: A number bond is just finding different pairs of smaller numbers that add up to a bigger number. It shows the parts that make the whole.
asks: How do I break down a number?
What does it mean to make a number?

faq.q: Can I use zero in number bonds?
faq.a: Yes, you can use zero. For example, five plus zero still equals five.
asks: Can zero be part of a number bond?

faq.q: Is 1 and 5 the same as 5 and 1?
faq.a: Yes, they are the same. When we add numbers, the order does not change the total. It is commutative.
asks: Is 1 plus 5 the same as 5 plus 1?

faq.q: How many ways can we make the number four?
faq.a: You can make four in several ways. For example, two and two, or three and one.
asks: Show me all the ways to make four.
What are the parts of four?

faq.q: Do I have to use only small numbers?
faq.a: You can use any pair of numbers that fit the total. The parts must always add up to the number you are looking at.
asks: Can the parts be big numbers?
What is the rule for the parts?

facts: Number bonds show how a whole number is made from smaller parts.
The parts must always add up to the total number.
The order of the parts does not change the total sum.
Five can be made by adding two and three.

quiz.say: Which pair makes the number five?
quiz.why: Two and three together make a total of five. This is a correct number bond.

wrong.0: This is tempting because the numbers are big, but five plus five is ten.
wrong.2: This is tempting because four plus zero is four, not five.
wrong.3: This is tempting because one plus one is only two, which is too small.

quiz.say: Show one way to make the number five.
quiz.why: Four and one are two numbers that correctly add up to five.

wrong.0: This is tempting because two plus two is four, not five.
wrong.1: This is tempting because the numbers look nice, but three plus three is six.
wrong.2: This is tempting because it uses the number five, but it adds up to ten.

quiz.say: If the total is five, what are the missing parts?
quiz.why: Three and two are two parts that correctly combine to make the whole number five.

wrong.0: This is tempting because it uses the number five, but it adds up to ten.
wrong.1: This is tempting because it is a simple addition, but it only equals four.
wrong.3: This is tempting because it makes five, but we are looking for a different correct pair.
